Use a custom Serializable class with mutable fields.

Test serialize to OutputStream: passing null outputStream throws IllegalArgumentException; ensure that serialization of null object works (output length?). Also test that outputStream is closed after operation; maybe use a custom OutputStream that records close.

Actually serialization fails if non-serializable field is not transient and not serializable). Use a class that implements Serializable but contains a non-serializable field (e.g., Object nonSerializable = new Object()). That will cause NotSerializableException on serialize; clone should throw SerializationException.
